This document contains the complete code for the analyses reported in the paper. It runs from the
IAN-AF 2015–2016 individual data (adults, with self-reported and measured height and weight), which
are not distributed with this repository; access can be requested from the IAN-AF consortium
(https://www.ian-af.up.pt/en/).

To reproduce the analyses, save the data file as `data/ianaf_adults.csv` (or point the environment
variable `PAPER5_DATA` to it) and render this document with Quarto. All tables are written to
`outputs/`. The sensitivity analysis with education in the calibration equations is obtained by
rendering with `PAPER5_EDU=1` and `PAPER5_OUT=outputs_with_edu`.



```{r setup}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE))
set.seed(123)

pkgs <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "survey", "mice", "ggplot2", "patchwork",
          "flextable", "officer")
for (p in pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(p)
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(p, character.only = TRUE))
}
# svyVGAM is only needed for Table 1 (survey-weighted multinomial models)
HAS_SVYVGAM <- requireNamespace("svyVGAM", quietly = TRUE)
if (HAS_SVYVGAM) suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(svyVGAM))

options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")

# ---- Settings ------------------------------------------------------------
DATA_FILE   <- Sys.getenv("PAPER5_DATA", "data/ianaf_adults.csv")
OUT_DIR     <- Sys.getenv("PAPER5_OUT",  "outputs")
N_BOOT      <- 500   # bootstrap replicates for differences between BMI methods
N_IMP       <- 20    # multiple imputations
N_SPLITS    <- 200   # repeated 70/30 splits (stability of the validation)
# Sensitivity analysis: exclude pairs with implausible self-report discrepancies
DISCREPANCY_LIMITS <- c(height_cm = 10, weight_kg = 15)

dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_csv <- function(x, name) write.csv(x, file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 1. Data preparation

```{r data}
raw <- read.csv(DATA_FILE, check.names = FALSE)

# Standardise variable names with janitor::clean_names()
if (requireNamespace("janitor", quietly = TRUE)) {
  raw <- janitor::clean_names(raw)
} else {
  snake <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", "\\1_\\2", x)
    x <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(x))
    gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
  }
  names(raw) <- snake(names(raw))
}
names(raw)[names(raw) %in% c("", "x", "v1")] <- "v1"
if ("ipaqlevel" %in% names(raw)) raw <- rename(raw, ipa_qlevel = ipaqlevel)

ian <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    psu2 = nut + 0.01 * uf,
    nut2 = nut,
    peso_rep   = ifelse(peso_rep   %in% c(888.8, 999.9), NA, peso_rep),
    peso_med   = ifelse(peso_med   %in% c(777.7, 999.9), NA, peso_med),
    altura_rep = ifelse(altura_rep %in% c(888.8, 999.9), NA, altura_rep),
    altura_med = ifelse(altura_med %in% c(777.7, 999.9), NA, altura_med),
    escol_prop = ifelse(escol_prop == 8, NA, escol_prop),
    rend       = ifelse(rend == 88, NA, rend),
    trab       = ifelse(trab %in% c(4, 8, 9), NA, trab)
  )

flow <- tibble(
  step = c("Total participants", "Non-pregnant", "Aged >= 18 years",
           "Complete self-reported and measured anthropometry"),
  n = c(nrow(ian),
        sum(ian$ind_gravida == 0),
        sum(ian$ind_gravida == 0 & ian$idade >= 18),
        sum(ian$ind_gravida == 0 & ian$idade >= 18 &
              !is.na(ian$peso_rep) & !is.na(ian$peso_med) &
              !is.na(ian$altura_rep) & !is.na(ian$altura_med)))
)
flow

dat <- ian %>%
  filter(ind_gravida == 0, idade >= 18,
         !is.na(peso_rep), !is.na(peso_med), !is.na(altura_rep), !is.na(altura_med)) %>%
  mutate(
    sexo = factor(sexo, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Female", "Male")),
    region = factor(nut2, levels = 1:7,
                    labels = c("North", "Center", "Lisbon M.A.", "Alentejo",
                               "Algarve", "A.R. Madeira", "A.R. Azores")),
    edu_rec = factor(case_when(
      escol_prop %in% 0:3 ~ "Low",            # up to 9th grade
      escol_prop %in% 4:5 ~ "Intermediate",   # 12th grade / post-secondary
      escol_prop == 6     ~ "High"),          # higher education
      levels = c("High", "Intermediate", "Low")),
    rend_rec = factor(case_when(
      rend %in% 1:2  ~ "Low",
      rend %in% 3:4  ~ "Intermediate",
      rend %in% 5:10 ~ "High"),
      levels = c("High", "Intermediate", "Low")),
    trab = factor(trab, levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                  labels = c("Employed", "Unemployed", "Other")),
    est_civ = factor(est_civ, levels = 1:4,
                     labels = c("Single", "Divorced", "Widowed", "Married/union")),
    # Anthropometry: biological plausibility limits only (no IQR deletion)
    plausible = between(altura_med, 120, 220) & between(altura_rep, 120, 220) &
                between(peso_med, 30, 250)    & between(peso_rep, 30, 250),
    bmi_med = peso_med / (altura_med / 100)^2,
    bmi_rep = peso_rep / (altura_rep / 100)^2,      # self-reported weight AND height
    alt_dif = altura_rep - altura_med,
    peso_dif = peso_rep - peso_med,
    bmi_dif = bmi_rep - bmi_med,
    altura_avg = (altura_rep + altura_med) / 2,
    peso_avg = (peso_rep + peso_med) / 2,
    bmi_avg = (bmi_rep + bmi_med) / 2,
    # complete case for the covariates used in the paper
    cc = !is.na(edu_rec) & !is.na(rend_rec) & !is.na(trab) & plausible,
    big_discrepancy = abs(alt_dif) > DISCREPANCY_LIMITS["height_cm"] |
                      abs(peso_dif) > DISCREPANCY_LIMITS["weight_kg"]
  )

bmi_cat <- function(b) factor(case_when(b < 25 ~ "Normal", b < 30 ~ "Pre-obesity",
                                        b >= 30 ~ "Obesity"),        # NA stays NA
                              levels = c("Normal", "Pre-obesity", "Obesity"))

dat <- dat %>% mutate(bmi_med_cat = bmi_cat(bmi_med), bmi_rep_cat = bmi_cat(bmi_rep))

cat("Analytic sample:", nrow(dat), "| implausible values:", sum(!dat$plausible),
    "| complete cases:", sum(dat$cc),
    "| large self-report discrepancies (sensitivity):", sum(dat$big_discrepancy), "\n")
table(dat$sexo, dat$cc)

# Full design: estimates for sex / complete-case groups are domain estimates
make_design <- function(d) svydesign(id = ~psu2, strata = ~nut2, weights = ~ponderador1,
                                     nest = TRUE, data = d)
des_all <- make_design(dat)
dom <- function(design, sx, extra = TRUE) {
  design$variables$.keep <- design$variables$cc & design$variables$sexo == sx & extra
  subset(design, .keep)
}
SEXES <- c(Women = "Female", Men = "Male")
# add / overwrite a variable inside a design (avoids get() inside update/subset)
setvar <- function(design, name, value) { design$variables[[name]] <- value; design }
n_dom <- function(design) sum(weights(design) > 0)
```

# 2. Descriptives (Table S13, Table S1, Table S3)

```{r descriptives}
wprop <- function(design, var) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0("~", var))
  m <- svymean(f, design, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(level = sub(var, "", names(coef(m))), pct = round(100 * coef(m), 1))
}
wmean <- function(design, var) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0("~", var))
  m <- svymean(f, design, na.rm = TRUE); v <- svyvar(f, design, na.rm = TRUE)
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", coef(m), sqrt(coef(v)))
}
table1 <- lapply(names(SEXES), function(lab) {
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab])
  bind_rows(
    tibble(variable = "Age, mean (SD)", level = "", value = wmean(d, "idade")),
    bind_rows(lapply(c("region", "edu_rec", "trab", "rend_rec"), function(v)
      wprop(d, v) %>% mutate(variable = v, value = paste0(pct, "%")) %>% select(-pct))),
    tibble(variable = c("Weight self-reported", "Weight measured", "Height self-reported",
                        "Height measured", "BMI self-reported", "BMI measured"),
           level = "mean (SD)",
           value = sapply(c("peso_rep", "peso_med", "altura_rep", "altura_med",
                            "bmi_rep", "bmi_med"), function(v) wmean(d, v)))
  ) %>% mutate(sex = lab)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = value)
table1
save_csv(table1, "Table1_weighted_descriptives")
save_csv(tibble(sex = names(SEXES),
                n_unweighted = sapply(SEXES, function(s) sum(dat$cc & dat$sexo == s)),
                pop_weighted = sapply(SEXES, function(s) round(sum(dat$ponderador1[dat$cc & dat$sexo == s])))),
         "Table1_sample_size")

# Table S1: complete vs incomplete cases (unweighted, among the analytic sample)
tableS1 <- dat %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(cc, "Complete", "Incomplete")) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), age_mean = round(mean(idade), 1), age_sd = round(sd(idade), 1),
            women_pct = round(100 * mean(sexo == "Female"), 1),
            high_edu_pct = round(100 * mean(edu_rec == "High", na.rm = TRUE), 1),
            employed_pct = round(100 * mean(trab == "Employed", na.rm = TRUE), 1),
            .groups = "drop")
tableS1
save_csv(tableS1, "TableS1_complete_vs_incomplete")
```

# 3. Magnitude of reporting bias (Tables S4–S5, Bland–Altman, LOESS)

```{r bias-magnitude}
bias_by_group <- function(diff_var, sx) {
  d <- dom(des_all, sx)
  d <- update(d, bmi_med_cat = bmi_med_cat)
  covs <- c(age_group = "age_grp", region = "region", education = "edu_rec",
            income = "rend_rec", employment = "trab", bmi = "bmi_med_cat")
  d <- update(d, age_grp = cut(idade, c(17, 29, 39, 49, 59, 69, 79, Inf),
                               labels = c("18-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59",
                                          "60-69", "70-79", ">=80")))
  bind_rows(lapply(names(covs), function(lab) {
    v <- covs[[lab]]
    est <- svyby(as.formula(paste0("~", diff_var)), as.formula(paste0("~", v)), d,
                 svymean, na.rm = TRUE)
    fit <- svyglm(as.formula(paste0(diff_var, " ~ ", v)), d)
    tibble(covariate = lab, category = as.character(est[[v]]),
           mean_diff = round(est[[diff_var]], 2), se = round(SE(est), 2),
           p_between = signif(regTermTest(fit, v)$p, 3))
  })) %>% mutate(sex = sx, outcome = diff_var)
}
tableS4_S5 <- bind_rows(lapply(SEXES, function(s)
  bind_rows(bias_by_group("alt_dif", s), bias_by_group("peso_dif", s), bias_by_group("bmi_dif", s))))
save_csv(tableS4_S5, "TableS4_S5_bias_by_group")

# Overall weighted mean bias and Bland–Altman limits of agreement
ba <- bind_rows(lapply(names(SEXES), function(lab) {
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab])
  bind_rows(lapply(c(height = "alt_dif", weight = "peso_dif", bmi = "bmi_dif"), function(v) {
    m <- svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", v)), d)
    sdv <- sqrt(coef(svyvar(as.formula(paste0("~", v)), d)))
    # proportional bias: regression of the difference on the mean of both methods
    avg <- switch(v, alt_dif = "altura_avg", peso_dif = "peso_avg", bmi_dif = "bmi_avg")
    pb <- svyglm(as.formula(paste0(v, " ~ ", avg)), d)
    m <- c(est = as.numeric(coef(m)), se = as.numeric(SE(m))); sdv <- as.numeric(sdv)
    tibble(sex = lab, measure = v, mean_diff = m[["est"]], se = m[["se"]],
           ci_low = m[["est"]] - 1.96 * m[["se"]], ci_high = m[["est"]] + 1.96 * m[["se"]],
           loa_low = m[["est"]] - 1.96 * sdv, loa_high = m[["est"]] + 1.96 * sdv,
           prop_bias_slope = coef(pb)[2], prop_bias_p = summary(pb)$coefficients[2, 4])
  }))
})) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
ba
save_csv(ba, "Bland_Altman_weighted")

ba_plot <- function(sx, meas, lab) {
  d <- dat %>% filter(cc, sexo == sx) %>%
    mutate(avg = (.data[[paste0(meas, "_rep")]] + .data[[paste0(meas, "_med")]]) / 2,
           dif = .data[[paste0(meas, "_rep")]] - .data[[paste0(meas, "_med")]])
  s <- ba %>% filter(sex == names(SEXES)[SEXES == sx],
                     measure == c(altura = "alt_dif", peso = "peso_dif")[meas])
  ggplot(d, aes(avg, dif)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = s$mean_diff, colour = "navy") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(s$loa_low, s$loa_high), colour = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(x = paste("Mean of self-reported and measured", lab),
         y = "Self-reported − measured", title = paste(lab, "–", names(SEXES)[SEXES == sx])) +
    theme_classic()
}
fig_ba <- (ba_plot("Female", "peso", "weight (kg)") | ba_plot("Male", "peso", "weight (kg)")) /
          (ba_plot("Female", "altura", "height (cm)") | ba_plot("Male", "altura", "height (cm)"))
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Figure_Bland_Altman.png"), fig_ba, width = 10, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# Age trends (survey-weighted LOESS)
loess_plot <- function(var, ylab) {
  ggplot(dat %>% filter(cc), aes(idade, .data[[var]], weight = ponderador1, colour = sexo)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 1, se = TRUE) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    labs(x = "Age (years)", y = ylab, colour = NULL) + theme_minimal()
}
fig_loess <- loess_plot("alt_dif", "Height bias (cm)") / loess_plot("peso_dif", "Weight bias (kg)") /
             loess_plot("bmi_dif", "BMI bias (kg/m²)")
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Figure_age_bias_loess.png"), fig_loess, width = 7, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# 4. Determinants of misreporting (Table 1 and Table S6)

```{r determinants}
reconstruct_last <- function(cf, vc, prefix, k) {
  idx <- grep(paste0("^", prefix, ".*:", k, "$"), names(cf))
  est <- -sum(cf[idx]); se <- sqrt(sum(vc[idx, idx]))
  c(est = est, se = se)
}
run_multinom <- function(outcome, h_thr, w_thr, sx) {
  d <- dat %>% mutate(
    y = case_when(
      outcome == "height" & abs(alt_dif)  <= h_thr ~ "ref",
      outcome == "height" & alt_dif  < -h_thr ~ "underreport",
      outcome == "height" & alt_dif  >  h_thr ~ "overreport",
      outcome == "weight" & abs(peso_dif) <= w_thr ~ "ref",
      outcome == "weight" & peso_dif < -w_thr ~ "underreport",
      outcome == "weight" & peso_dif >  w_thr ~ "overreport"),
    y = factor(y, levels = c("ref", "underreport", "overreport")),
    region_e = region)
  contrasts(d$region_e) <- contr.sum(7)
  des <- make_design(d)
  des <- subset(des, cc & sexo == sx)
  fit <- svy_vglm(y ~ idade + region_e + edu_rec + rend_rec + trab + bmi_med_cat,
                  design = des, family = VGAM::multinomial(refLevel = "ref"))
  cf <- coef(fit); vc <- vcov(fit)
  res <- tibble(term = names(cf), est = cf, se = sqrt(diag(vc)))
  for (k in 1:2) {
    r <- reconstruct_last(cf, vc, "region_e", k)
    res <- bind_rows(res, tibble(term = paste0("region_e7:", k), est = r["est"], se = r["se"]))
  }
  res %>% filter(!grepl("Intercept", term)) %>%
    mutate(comparison = ifelse(grepl(":1$", term), "Underreport vs no bias", "Overreport vs no bias"),
           term = sub(":[12]$", "", term),
           term = sub("region_e([1-7])", "region_\\1", term),
           OR = exp(est), lo = exp(est - 1.96 * se), hi = exp(est + 1.96 * se),
           p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se)),
           `OR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", OR, lo, hi),
           sex = sx, outcome = outcome)
}
if (HAS_SVYVGAM) {
  table2 <- bind_rows(lapply(SEXES, function(s) bind_rows(
    run_multinom("height", 0.5, 1, s), run_multinom("weight", 0.5, 1, s))))
  tableS3 <- bind_rows(lapply(SEXES, function(s) bind_rows(
    run_multinom("height", 1, 2, s), run_multinom("weight", 1, 2, s))))
  # region_1..region_7 = North, Center, Lisbon, Alentejo, Algarve, Madeira, Azores (vs overall mean)
  save_csv(table2, "Table2_multinomial_0.5cm_1kg")
  save_csv(tableS3, "TableS3_multinomial_1cm_2kg")
} else message("svyVGAM not installed: Table 1 / Table S6 skipped")
```

# 5. Calibration equations

## 5.1 Backward selection (Wald tests, p < 0.05)

```{r selection}
backward <- function(design, outcome, rep_var, candidates, alpha = 0.05) {
  current <- candidates; steps <- list()
  repeat {
    f <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(rep_var, current), collapse = " + ")))
    fit <- svyglm(f, design)
    p <- sapply(current, function(v) regTermTest(fit, v)$p)
    steps[[length(steps) + 1]] <- tibble(step = length(steps) + 1, term = current,
                                         p = signif(as.numeric(p), 3))
    if (max(p) < alpha || length(current) == 0) break
    current <- current[-which.max(p)]
  }
  list(selected = current, steps = bind_rows(steps), fit = fit)
}
CANDIDATES <- c("idade", "region", "edu_rec", "rend_rec", "trab")
selection <- list()
for (lab in names(SEXES)) {
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab])
  selection[[paste(lab, "weight")]] <- backward(d, "peso_med", "peso_rep", CANDIDATES)
  selection[[paste(lab, "height")]] <- backward(d, "altura_med", "altura_rep", CANDIDATES)
}
sel_table <- bind_rows(lapply(names(selection), function(n)
  selection[[n]]$steps %>% mutate(model = n)))
sel_summary <- tibble(model = names(selection),
                      selected = sapply(selection, function(x) paste(x$selected, collapse = ", ")))
sel_summary
save_csv(sel_table, "Calibration_backward_selection_steps")
save_csv(sel_summary, "Calibration_backward_selection_result")
```

## 5.2 Final models

The main models use age and region only (common set for both sexes and both outcomes).
Education was retained by backward selection in two of the four models but did not improve
prediction or classification and inflated relative educational inequalities, so equations
with education are a sensitivity analysis (Supplementary Table S8). To reproduce Table S8,
render with the environment variables `PAPER5_EDU=1` and `PAPER5_OUT=outputs_with_edu`.

```{r calibration}
FINAL_COVARS <- if (Sys.getenv("PAPER5_EDU", "0") == "1") c("idade", "region", "edu_rec") else c("idade", "region")

calib_models <- list()
for (lab in names(SEXES)) {
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab])
  calib_models[[lab]] <- list(
    weight = svyglm(as.formula(paste("peso_med ~ peso_rep +", paste(FINAL_COVARS, collapse = " + "))), d),
    height = svyglm(as.formula(paste("altura_med ~ altura_rep +", paste(FINAL_COVARS, collapse = " + "))), d))
}
apply_calibration <- function(df, models) {
  df$peso_cal <- NA_real_; df$altura_cal <- NA_real_
  for (lab in names(SEXES)) {
    i <- which(df$sexo == SEXES[lab] & complete.cases(df[, c("peso_rep", "altura_rep", FINAL_COVARS)]))
    df$peso_cal[i]   <- predict(models[[lab]]$weight, newdata = df[i, ], type = "response")
    df$altura_cal[i] <- predict(models[[lab]]$height, newdata = df[i, ], type = "response")
  }
  df %>% mutate(bmi_cal = peso_cal / (altura_cal / 100)^2, bmi_cal_cat = bmi_cat(bmi_cal))
}
dat <- apply_calibration(dat, calib_models)
des_all <- make_design(dat)

tableS6 <- bind_rows(lapply(names(SEXES), function(lab) bind_rows(lapply(c("weight", "height"), function(o) {
  m <- calib_models[[lab]][[o]]; ci <- confint(m)
  tibble(sex = lab, outcome = o, term = names(coef(m)),
         `Coefficient (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f to %.3f)", coef(m), ci[, 1], ci[, 2]))
}))))
tableS6
save_csv(tableS6, "TableS6_calibration_coefficients")

# Extra predictors tested (smoking, physical activity, marital status): change in fit
extra_check <- bind_rows(lapply(names(SEXES), function(lab) {
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab], extra = !is.na(dat$fum_fuma_atual_adulto) &
                                         !is.na(dat$ipa_qlevel) & !is.na(dat$est_civ))
  bind_rows(lapply(c(weight = "peso", height = "altura"), function(v) {
    base <- svyglm(as.formula(paste0(v, "_med ~ ", v, "_rep + ", paste(FINAL_COVARS, collapse = " + "))), d)
    ext  <- update(base, . ~ . + factor(fum_fuma_atual_adulto) + factor(ipa_qlevel) + est_civ)
    rmse <- function(m) sqrt(sum(m$prior.weights * residuals(m, type = "response")^2) / sum(m$prior.weights))
    tibble(sex = lab, outcome = v, n = n_dom(d),
           rmse_final = rmse(base), rmse_extended = rmse(ext),
           p_extra_terms = as.numeric(regTermTest(ext, ~ factor(fum_fuma_atual_adulto) + factor(ipa_qlevel) + est_civ)$p))
  }))
})) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 4)))
extra_check
save_csv(extra_check, "Calibration_extra_predictors_check")
```

## 5.3 Split-sample internal validation (70/30) of the height and weight equations

```{r validation}
validate_once <- function(seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  d <- dat %>% filter(cc)
  d$split <- ifelse(runif(nrow(d)) < 0.7, "train", "test")
  out <- list()
  for (lab in names(SEXES)) {
    tr <- make_design(d %>% filter(sexo == SEXES[lab], split == "train"))
    mw <- svyglm(as.formula(paste("peso_med ~ peso_rep +", paste(FINAL_COVARS, collapse = " + "))), tr)
    mh <- svyglm(as.formula(paste("altura_med ~ altura_rep +", paste(FINAL_COVARS, collapse = " + "))), tr)
    te <- d %>% filter(sexo == SEXES[lab], split == "test")
    te$bmi_cal_v <- predict(mw, newdata = te, type = "response") /
                    (predict(mh, newdata = te, type = "response") / 100)^2
    w <- te$ponderador1
    slope_fit <- lm(bmi_med ~ bmi_cal_v, data = te, weights = w)
    ob_m <- te$bmi_med >= 30; ob_c <- te$bmi_cal_v >= 30; ob_r <- te$bmi_rep >= 30
    out[[lab]] <- tibble(
      sex = lab, n_test = nrow(te),
      citl_cal = weighted.mean(te$bmi_med - te$bmi_cal_v, w),
      citl_rep = weighted.mean(te$bmi_med - te$bmi_rep, w),
      slope_cal = coef(slope_fit)[2],
      slope_rep = coef(lm(bmi_med ~ bmi_rep, data = te, weights = w))[2],
      mae_cal = weighted.mean(abs(te$bmi_med - te$bmi_cal_v), w),
      mae_rep = weighted.mean(abs(te$bmi_med - te$bmi_rep), w),
      rmse_cal = sqrt(weighted.mean((te$bmi_med - te$bmi_cal_v)^2, w)),
      rmse_rep = sqrt(weighted.mean((te$bmi_med - te$bmi_rep)^2, w)),
      sens_obesity_cal = sum(w[ob_m & ob_c]) / sum(w[ob_m]),
      sens_obesity_rep = sum(w[ob_m & ob_r]) / sum(w[ob_m]),
      spec_obesity_cal = sum(w[!ob_m & !ob_c]) / sum(w[!ob_m]),
      spec_obesity_rep = sum(w[!ob_m & !ob_r]) / sum(w[!ob_m]))
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}
validation_main <- validate_once(123)                     # the reported 70/30 split
validation_rep  <- bind_rows(lapply(1:N_SPLITS, validate_once)) %>%  # stability over splits
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(across(-n_test, list(mean = mean, p2.5 = ~ quantile(.x, .025), p97.5 = ~ quantile(.x, .975))),
            .groups = "drop")
validation_main %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
save_csv(validation_main %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))), "Validation_70_30")
save_csv(validation_rep %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))), "Validation_70_30_repeated")
```

## 5.4 Additional candidate predictors

Candidates that are available in self-reported surveys and do not depend on measurement:
non-linear terms (age², self-reported value², self-reported × age), self-rated health,
household size and, as a sensitivity analysis only (it may not exist in every survey where the
equations are applied), chronic disease. A model without socioeconomic variables (age + region)
is also shown, because using education in the calibration and then estimating education
inequalities is partly circular. All models are compared on the same sample.

```{r candidates}
dat <- dat %>% mutate(
  saude3 = factor(case_when(saude %in% 1:2 ~ "Excellent/good", saude == 3 ~ "Fair",
                            saude %in% 4:5 ~ "Poor/very poor"),
                  levels = c("Excellent/good", "Fair", "Poor/very poor")),
  ag_fam5 = factor(case_when(ag_fam %in% 1:4 ~ as.character(ag_fam),
                             ag_fam >= 5 & ag_fam < 99 ~ "5+"),
                   levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5+")),
  doenca_f = factor(doenca, levels = 0:1, labels = c("No", "Yes")),
  cand_ok = cc & !is.na(saude3) & !is.na(ag_fam5) & !is.na(doenca_f))
des_all <- make_design(dat)

# "{v}" is replaced by peso / altura
SPECS <- list(
  `Final (age + region + education)` = c("idade", "region", "edu_rec"),
  `No SEP (age + region)`            = c("idade", "region"),
  `Final + non-linear terms`         = c("idade", "region", "edu_rec", "I(idade^2)",
                                         "I({v}_rep^2)", "{v}_rep:idade"),
  `Final + self-rated health`        = c("idade", "region", "edu_rec", "saude3"),
  `Final + household size`           = c("idade", "region", "edu_rec", "ag_fam5"),
  `Final + chronic disease (sens.)`  = c("idade", "region", "edu_rec", "doenca_f"))
spec_formula <- function(v, covars)
  as.formula(paste0(v, "_med ~ ", v, "_rep + ", gsub("{v}", v, paste(covars, collapse = " + "), fixed = TRUE)))
added_terms <- function(v, spec) {
  extra <- setdiff(SPECS[[spec]], SPECS[[1]])
  if (length(extra) == 0) return(NULL)
  as.formula(paste("~", gsub("{v}", v, paste(extra, collapse = " + "), fixed = TRUE)))
}
rmse_w <- function(m) sqrt(sum(m$prior.weights * residuals(m, type = "response")^2) / sum(m$prior.weights))

# (a) In-sample fit of the height and weight equations
cand_fit <- bind_rows(lapply(names(SEXES), function(lab) {
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab], extra = dat$cand_ok)
  bind_rows(lapply(c(weight = "peso", height = "altura"), function(v) {
    bind_rows(lapply(names(SPECS), function(s) {
      m <- svyglm(spec_formula(v, SPECS[[s]]), d)
      at <- added_terms(v, s)
      tibble(sex = lab, outcome = ifelse(v == "peso", "weight", "height"), model = s,
             n = n_dom(d), rmse = rmse_w(m), aic = AIC(m)["AIC"],
             p_added_terms = if (is.null(at)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(regTermTest(m, at)$p))
    }))
  }))
})) %>% mutate(across(c(rmse, aic), ~ round(.x, 3)), p_added_terms = signif(p_added_terms, 3))
cand_fit
save_csv(cand_fit, "Calibration_candidate_predictors_fit")

# (b) Repeated 70/30 validation of the resulting calibrated BMI
validate_spec <- function(covars, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  d <- dat %>% filter(cand_ok)
  d$split <- ifelse(runif(nrow(d)) < 0.7, "train", "test")
  bind_rows(lapply(names(SEXES), function(lab) {
    tr <- make_design(d %>% filter(sexo == SEXES[lab], split == "train"))
    te <- d %>% filter(sexo == SEXES[lab], split == "test")
    mw <- svyglm(spec_formula("peso", covars), tr)
    mh <- svyglm(spec_formula("altura", covars), tr)
    b <- predict(mw, newdata = te, type = "response") / (predict(mh, newdata = te, type = "response") / 100)^2
    w <- te$ponderador1; ob_m <- te$bmi_med >= 30; ob_c <- b >= 30
    tibble(sex = lab,
           citl = weighted.mean(te$bmi_med - b, w),
           slope = coef(lm(te$bmi_med ~ b, weights = w))[2],
           mae = weighted.mean(abs(te$bmi_med - b), w),
           rmse = sqrt(weighted.mean((te$bmi_med - b)^2, w)),
           sens_obesity = sum(w[ob_m & ob_c]) / sum(w[ob_m]),
           spec_obesity = sum(w[!ob_m & !ob_c]) / sum(w[!ob_m]),
           prev_diff_obesity = 100 * (sum(w[ob_c]) - sum(w[ob_m])) / sum(w))
  }))
}
cand_validation <- bind_rows(lapply(names(SPECS), function(s)
  bind_rows(lapply(1:N_SPLITS, function(i) validate_spec(SPECS[[s]], i))) %>% mutate(model = s))) %>%
  group_by(sex, model) %>%
  summarise(across(citl:prev_diff_obesity, ~ sprintf("%.3f (%.3f; %.3f)", mean(.x),
                                                    quantile(.x, .025), quantile(.x, .975))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = names(SPECS))) %>% arrange(sex, model)
cand_validation
save_csv(cand_validation, "Calibration_candidate_predictors_validation")
```

# 6. Agreement (Tables S10–S12)

```{r agreement}
# S10: weighted means
tableS7 <- bind_rows(lapply(names(SEXES), function(lab) {
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab])
  m <- svymean(~ peso_med + peso_rep + peso_cal + altura_med + altura_rep + altura_cal +
                 bmi_med + bmi_rep + bmi_cal, d, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(sex = lab, variable = names(coef(m)), mean = round(coef(m), 2), se = round(SE(m), 2))
}))
save_csv(tableS7, "TableS7_means")

# S12: cross-classification (row %), overall agreement and weighted kappa
agree_tab <- function(design, cat_var) {
  t <- svytable(as.formula(paste("~ bmi_med_cat +", cat_var)), design)
  p <- prop.table(t)
  po <- sum(diag(p)); pe <- sum(rowSums(p) * colSums(p))
  wts <- 1 - abs(outer(1:3, 1:3, "-")) / 2                     # linear weights
  pow <- sum(wts * p); pew <- sum(wts * outer(rowSums(p), colSums(p)))
  list(row_pct = round(100 * prop.table(t, 1), 1), agreement = round(100 * po, 1),
       kappa = round((po - pe) / (1 - pe), 3), kappa_w = round((pow - pew) / (1 - pew), 3))
}
tableS8 <- list()
for (lab in names(SEXES)) {
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab])
  tableS8[[paste(lab, "self-reported")]] <- agree_tab(d, "bmi_rep_cat")
  tableS8[[paste(lab, "calibrated")]]    <- agree_tab(d, "bmi_cal_cat")
}
tableS8
tableS8_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(tableS8), function(n) {
  x <- as.data.frame(tableS8[[n]]$row_pct); names(x) <- c("measured", "comparison", "row_pct")
  x %>% pivot_wider(names_from = comparison, values_from = row_pct) %>%
    mutate(table = n, overall_agreement = tableS8[[n]]$agreement,
           kappa = tableS8[[n]]$kappa, kappa_weighted = tableS8[[n]]$kappa_w, .before = 1)
}))
save_csv(tableS8_df, "TableS8_agreement")

# S11: survey-weighted Lin's CCC with bootstrap (replicate-weight) CIs
ccc_w <- function(x, y, w) {
  W <- sum(w); mx <- sum(w * x) / W; my <- sum(w * y) / W
  sx <- sum(w * (x - mx)^2) / W; sy <- sum(w * (y - my)^2) / W
  sxy <- sum(w * (x - mx) * (y - my)) / W
  2 * sxy / (sx + sy + (mx - my)^2)
}
tableS9 <- bind_rows(lapply(names(SEXES), function(lab) {
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab])
  rd <- as.svrepdesign(d, type = "subbootstrap", replicates = N_BOOT)
  pairs <- list(weight_rep = c("peso_med", "peso_rep"), weight_cal = c("peso_med", "peso_cal"),
                height_rep = c("altura_med", "altura_rep"), height_cal = c("altura_med", "altura_cal"),
                bmi_rep = c("bmi_med", "bmi_rep"), bmi_cal = c("bmi_med", "bmi_cal"))
  est <- withReplicates(rd, function(w, df) sapply(pairs, function(p) ccc_w(df[[p[1]]], df[[p[2]]], w)))
  tibble(sex = lab, comparison = names(pairs), CCC = round(coef(est), 3),
         ci_low = round(coef(est) - 1.96 * SE(est), 3), ci_high = round(coef(est) + 1.96 * SE(est), 3))
}))
tableS9
save_csv(tableS9, "TableS9_CCC")
```

# 7. Prevalence by BMI method and tests (Table 2)

```{r table3}
table3 <- list(); table3_tests <- list()
for (lab in names(SEXES)) {
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab])
  d <- update(d,
    m_N = as.numeric(bmi_med_cat == "Normal"), m_P = as.numeric(bmi_med_cat == "Pre-obesity"),
    m_O = as.numeric(bmi_med_cat == "Obesity"),
    r_N = as.numeric(bmi_rep_cat == "Normal"), r_P = as.numeric(bmi_rep_cat == "Pre-obesity"),
    r_O = as.numeric(bmi_rep_cat == "Obesity"),
    c_N = as.numeric(bmi_cal_cat == "Normal"), c_P = as.numeric(bmi_cal_cat == "Pre-obesity"),
    c_O = as.numeric(bmi_cal_cat == "Obesity"))
  for (k in c(N = "Normal", P = "Pre-obesity", O = "Obesity")) {
    kk <- names(which(c(N = "Normal", P = "Pre-obesity", O = "Obesity") == k))
    est <- svymean(as.formula(paste0("~ m_", kk, " + r_", kk, " + c_", kk)), d)
    dr <- svycontrast(est, setNames(c(-1, 1, 0), names(coef(est))))
    dc <- svycontrast(est, setNames(c(-1, 0, 1), names(coef(est))))
    ci <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f (%.1f to %.1f)", 100 * coef(x), 100 * (coef(x) - 1.96 * SE(x)),
                              100 * (coef(x) + 1.96 * SE(x)))
    table3[[paste(lab, k)]] <- tibble(
      sex = lab, category = k,
      measured = ci(svycontrast(est, setNames(c(1, 0, 0), names(coef(est))))),
      self_reported = ci(svycontrast(est, setNames(c(0, 1, 0), names(coef(est))))),
      calibrated = ci(svycontrast(est, setNames(c(0, 0, 1), names(coef(est))))),
      diff_selfrep_vs_measured_pp = ci(dr), p_selfrep = signif(as.numeric(2 * pnorm(-abs(coef(dr) / SE(dr)))), 3),
      diff_calibrated_vs_measured_pp = ci(dc), p_calibrated = signif(as.numeric(2 * pnorm(-abs(coef(dc) / SE(dc)))), 3))
  }
  # Overall test of marginal homogeneity (design-based Wald test, 2 df)
  mh <- function(pref) {
    est <- svymean(as.formula(paste0("~ I(", pref, "_N - m_N) + I(", pref, "_O - m_O)")), d)
    b <- coef(est); V <- vcov(est); X2 <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% solve(V) %*% b)
    dfd <- degf(d)
    Fst <- X2 / 2
    c(Wald_chi2 = X2, p_chi2 = pchisq(X2, 2, lower.tail = FALSE),
      F = Fst, p_F = pf(Fst, 2, dfd, lower.tail = FALSE))
  }
  table3_tests[[lab]] <- bind_rows(
    c(sex = lab, comparison = "self-reported vs measured", round(mh("r"), 4)),
    c(sex = lab, comparison = "calibrated vs measured", round(mh("c"), 4)))
}
table3 <- bind_rows(table3); table3_tests <- bind_rows(table3_tests)
table3; table3_tests
save_csv(table3, "Table3_prevalence_and_differences")
save_csv(table3_tests, "Table3_marginal_homogeneity_tests")
```

# 8. Socioeconomic inequalities in obesity (Table 3)

PD/PR: low vs high (extreme categories, high = reference); employment: unemployed
vs employed. SII/RII: sex-specific weighted ridit scores (0 = most advantaged).
Employment in SII/RII uses the same two groups (employed, unemployed); the
"other" employment situation is excluded from the employment contrasts.

```{r inequalities}
dat <- dat %>% mutate(
  ob_med = as.numeric(bmi_med >= 30), ob_rep = as.numeric(bmi_rep >= 30),
  ob_cal = as.numeric(bmi_cal >= 30),
  emp2 = factor(case_when(trab == "Employed" ~ "High", trab == "Unemployed" ~ "Low"),
                levels = c("High", "Low")))
des_all <- make_design(dat)
SEP <- c(Education = "edu_rec", Income = "rend_rec", Employment = "emp2")
OUT <- c(Measured = "ob_med", `Self-reported` = "ob_rep", Calibrated = "ob_cal")

ridit <- function(x, w) {           # x ordered High -> Low, returns ridit per observation
  tw <- tapply(w, x, sum); tw <- tw[!is.na(tw)]
  cum <- cumsum(tw) / sum(tw); r <- cum - (tw / sum(tw)) / 2
  unname(r[as.character(x)])
}

# Point estimates and CIs with svyglm (as in the manuscript)
ineq_fits <- function(design, y, sep) {
  x <- design$variables[[sep]]
  design <- setvar(design, ".ext", x %in% c("High", "Low"))
  design <- setvar(design, ".low", as.numeric(x == "Low"))
  design <- setvar(design, ".rid", design$variables[[paste0(sep, "_rid")]])
  dd <- subset(design, .ext)
  list(PD = svyglm(as.formula(paste(y, "~ .low")), dd),
       logPR = svyglm(as.formula(paste(y, "~ .low")), dd, family = quasipoisson(link = "log")),
       SII = svyglm(as.formula(paste(y, "~ .rid")), design),
       logRII = svyglm(as.formula(paste(y, "~ .rid")), design, family = quasipoisson(link = "log")))
}
ineq_svy <- function(design, y, sep) {
  fits <- ineq_fits(design, y, sep)
  pd <- fits$PD; pr <- fits$logPR; sii <- fits$SII; rii <- fits$logRII
  f <- function(m, expo, scale) {
    b <- coef(m)[2]; s <- SE(m)[2]
    if (expo) sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", exp(b), exp(b - 1.96 * s), exp(b + 1.96 * s))
    else sprintf("%.1f (%.1f to %.1f)", scale * b, scale * (b - 1.96 * s), scale * (b + 1.96 * s))
  }
  c(PD = f(pd, FALSE, 100), PR = f(pr, TRUE), SII = f(sii, FALSE, 100), RII = f(rii, TRUE))
}

# Fast weighted estimates for bootstrap replicates (differences between methods)
ineq_fast <- function(df, w, y, sep) {
  i <- !is.na(df[[sep]]) & !is.na(df[[y]])
  x <- df[[sep]][i]; yy <- df[[y]][i]; ww <- w[i]
  hi <- x == "High"; lo <- x == "Low"
  p_hi <- sum(ww[hi] * yy[hi]) / sum(ww[hi]); p_lo <- sum(ww[lo] * yy[lo]) / sum(ww[lo])
  r <- ridit(x, ww)
  sii <- coef(lm.wfit(cbind(1, r), yy, ww))[2]
  rii <- coef(suppressWarnings(glm.fit(cbind(1, r), yy, weights = ww,
                                       family = quasipoisson(link = "log"))))[2]
  c(PD = 100 * (p_lo - p_hi), logPR = log(p_lo / p_hi), SII = 100 * sii, logRII = rii)
}

table4 <- list(); table4_diff <- list()
for (lab in names(SEXES)) {
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab])
  dv <- d$variables
  for (s in SEP) dv[[paste0(s, "_rid")]] <- ridit(dv[[s]], dv$ponderador1)
  d$variables <- dv
  for (sl in names(SEP)) for (ol in names(OUT))
    table4[[paste(lab, sl, ol)]] <- c(sex = lab, SEP = sl, BMI = ol, ineq_svy(d, OUT[[ol]], SEP[[sl]]))

  # Bootstrap: SE and CI of the difference (self-reported − measured; calibrated − measured)
  rd <- as.svrepdesign(d, type = "subbootstrap", replicates = N_BOOT)
  stat_fun <- function(w, df) {
    unlist(lapply(names(SEP), function(sl) {
      m <- ineq_fast(df, w, "ob_med", SEP[[sl]])
      r <- ineq_fast(df, w, "ob_rep", SEP[[sl]])
      cc <- ineq_fast(df, w, "ob_cal", SEP[[sl]])
      setNames(c(r - m, cc - m),
               c(paste(sl, "SR-M", names(m)), paste(sl, "Cal-M", names(m))))
    }))
  }
  bt <- withReplicates(rd, stat_fun)
  table4_diff[[lab]] <- tibble(sex = lab, contrast = names(coef(bt)),
                               diff = coef(bt), se = SE(bt)) %>%
    mutate(ci_low = diff - 1.96 * se, ci_high = diff + 1.96 * se,
           p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(diff / se)),
           # PR and RII differences are on the log scale: report the ratio of ratios
           ratio_of_ratios = ifelse(grepl("log", contrast), exp(diff), NA),
           ror_ci_low = ifelse(grepl("log", contrast), exp(ci_low), NA),
           ror_ci_high = ifelse(grepl("log", contrast), exp(ci_high), NA))
}
table4 <- bind_rows(lapply(table4, function(x) as_tibble(as.list(x))))
table4_diff <- bind_rows(table4_diff) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
table4
table4_diff
save_csv(table4, "Table4_inequalities")
save_csv(table4_diff, "Table4_differences_between_methods_bootstrap")
```

# 9b. Associations with health indicators (Table 4)

Associations of obesity (and BMI per 1 kg/m²) with chronic disease, fair/poor self-rated
health and measured abdominal obesity, by BMI method: survey-weighted Poisson regression
(prevalence ratios) adjusted for age and region, by sex. Differences between methods are
ratios of prevalence ratios (self-reported or calibrated / measured) with bootstrap CIs.

```{r health-associations}
dat <- dat %>% mutate(
  ob_med = as.numeric(bmi_med >= 30), ob_rep = as.numeric(bmi_rep >= 30),
  ob_cal = as.numeric(bmi_cal >= 30),
  chronic  = ifelse(doenca %in% 0:1, doenca, NA),                        # any chronic disease (self-reported)
  srh      = ifelse(saude %in% 1:5, saude, NA),                           # self-rated health score, 1 = excellent ... 5 = very poor; 8 = NA
  waist    = ifelse(is.na(cint_med) | cint_med > 200, NA, cint_med))   # measured waist circumference (cm)
des_all <- make_design(dat)
HEALTH <- c(`Chronic disease` = "chronic",
            `Self-rated health score (1-5)` = "srh",
            `Waist circumference (cm)` = "waist")
EXPO <- list(Measured = c("ob_med", "bmi_med"), `Self-reported` = c("ob_rep", "bmi_rep"),
             Calibrated = c("ob_cal", "bmi_cal"))
ADJ <- "idade + region"

CONTINUOUS <- c("srh", "waist")   # linear regression (mean difference); binary outcomes: Poisson (prevalence ratio)
fam <- function(y) if (y %in% CONTINUOUS) gaussian() else quasipoisson(link = "log")
# survey-weighted regression: PR (or mean difference) for obesity and per 1 kg/m2 BMI
health_pr <- function(d, y, x) {
  m <- svyglm(as.formula(paste(y, "~", x, "+", ADJ)), d, family = fam(y))
  b <- coef(m)[x]; s <- SE(m)[x]
  if (y %in% CONTINUOUS) sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", b, b - 1.96 * s, b + 1.96 * s)
  else sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", exp(b), exp(b - 1.96 * s), exp(b + 1.96 * s))
}
health_fast <- function(df, w, y, x) {
  i <- !is.na(df[[y]]); X <- model.matrix(as.formula(paste("~", x, "+", ADJ)), df[i, ])
  coef(suppressWarnings(glm.fit(X, df[[y]][i], weights = w[i], family = fam(y))))[2]
}
tableS13 <- list(); tableS13_diff <- list()
for (lab in names(SEXES)) for (hl in names(HEALTH)) {
  y <- HEALTH[[hl]]
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab], extra = !is.na(dat[[y]]))
  prev <- svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", y)), d)
  row <- c(sex = lab, outcome = hl, n = n_dom(d), prevalence = if (y %in% CONTINUOUS) sprintf("mean %.1f", coef(prev)) else sprintf("%.1f", 100 * coef(prev)))
  for (ml in names(EXPO)) {
    row[paste(ml, "obesity")] <- health_pr(d, y, EXPO[[ml]][1])
    row[paste(ml, "BMI per kg/m2")] <- health_pr(d, y, EXPO[[ml]][2])
  }
  tableS13[[paste(lab, hl)]] <- row
  # bootstrap: ratio of PRs (self-reported / measured; calibrated / measured); difference of mean differences for SRH score
  rd <- as.svrepdesign(d, type = "subbootstrap", replicates = N_BOOT)
  stat_fun <- function(w, df) {
    keep <- w > 0
    unlist(lapply(c(obesity = 1, BMI = 2), function(k) {
      m <- health_fast(df[keep, ], w[keep], y, EXPO$Measured[k])
      c(`SR/M` = health_fast(df[keep, ], w[keep], y, EXPO$`Self-reported`[k]) - m,
        `Cal/M` = health_fast(df[keep, ], w[keep], y, EXPO$Calibrated[k]) - m)
    }))
  }
  bt <- withReplicates(rd, stat_fun)
  tr <- if (y %in% CONTINUOUS) identity else exp
  tableS13_diff[[paste(lab, hl)]] <- tibble(sex = lab, outcome = hl, contrast = names(coef(bt)),
    ratio_or_diff = tr(coef(bt)), ci_low = tr(coef(bt) - 1.96 * SE(bt)), ci_high = tr(coef(bt) + 1.96 * SE(bt)),
    p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(coef(bt) / SE(bt))))
}
tableS13 <- bind_rows(lapply(tableS13, function(x) as_tibble(as.list(x))))
tableS13_diff <- bind_rows(tableS13_diff) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
tableS13
tableS13_diff
save_csv(tableS13, "TableS13_health_associations")
save_csv(tableS13_diff, "TableS13_ratio_of_PR_bootstrap")

# ---- Table S14: prevalence (or mean) of health indicators by obesity status, BMI method and sex
dat <- dat %>% mutate(srh5 = factor(c("Excellent", "Good", "Fair", "Poor", "Very poor")[ifelse(saude %in% 1:5, saude, NA)],
                                     levels = c("Excellent", "Good", "Fair", "Poor", "Very poor")))
des_all <- make_design(dat)
OUTC <- list(`Chronic disease` = "chronic", `Self-rated health` = "srh5",
             `Waist circumference (cm), mean` = "waist")
fmt_p <- function(m, s) sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", 100 * m, 100 * pmax(m - 1.96 * s, 0), 100 * pmin(m + 1.96 * s, 1))
prev_health <- list()
for (lab in names(SEXES)) for (ol in names(OUTC)) {
  y <- OUTC[[ol]]
  d <- dom(des_all, SEXES[lab], extra = !is.na(dat[[y]]))
  for (meth in names(EXPO)) {
    x <- EXPO[[meth]][1]
    for (ob in 0:1) {
      dd <- subset(d, get(x) == ob)
      est <- svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", y)), dd, na.rm = TRUE)
      m <- coef(est); s <- SE(est)
      lev <- if (y == "srh5") sub("srh5", "", names(m)) else if (y == "waist") "Mean" else "Yes"
      if (y != "srh5") { m <- m[1]; s <- s[1] }
      prev_health[[length(prev_health) + 1]] <- tibble(sex = lab, outcome = ol, category = lev, method = meth,
        obesity = ifelse(ob == 1, "Obesity", "No obesity"), n = sum(dd$variables[[x]] == ob, na.rm = TRUE),
        prev = if (y == "waist") sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", m, m - 1.96 * s, m + 1.96 * s) else fmt_p(m, s))
    }
  }
}
prev_health <- bind_rows(prev_health) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(sex, outcome, category), names_from = c(method, obesity),
                     values_from = prev, names_sep = ": ")
print(prev_health, width = Inf)
save_csv(prev_health, "TableS13_health_prevalence_by_obesity_method")
```

# 10. Multiple imputation (Table S2)

```{r mice}
mi_base <- dat %>% filter(plausible) %>%
  select(sexo, idade, region, psu2, nut2, ponderador1, edu_rec, rend_rec, trab,
         peso_med, altura_med, peso_rep, altura_rep) %>%
  mutate(edu_rec = factor(edu_rec, ordered = TRUE), rend_rec = factor(rend_rec, ordered = TRUE),
         bmi_med = peso_med / (altura_med / 100)^2)
meth <- make.method(mi_base)
meth[] <- ""
meth[c("edu_rec", "rend_rec")] <- "polr"
meth["trab"] <- "polyreg"
pred <- make.predictorMatrix(mi_base)
pred[, c("psu2", "nut2")] <- 0          # design identifiers are not used as predictors (region is)
imp <- mice(mi_base, m = N_IMP, method = meth, predictorMatrix = pred, printFlag = FALSE, seed = 123)

mi_one <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>% mutate(edu_rec = factor(edu_rec, ordered = FALSE, levels = c("High", "Intermediate", "Low")),
                      rend_rec = factor(rend_rec, ordered = FALSE, levels = c("High", "Intermediate", "Low")),
                      bmi_rep = peso_rep / (altura_rep / 100)^2, cc = TRUE)
  # re-estimate the calibration equations in each imputed dataset
  dsg <- make_design(df)
  mods <- lapply(SEXES, function(s) {
    ds <- subset(dsg, sexo == s)
    list(weight = svyglm(as.formula(paste("peso_med ~ peso_rep +", paste(FINAL_COVARS, collapse = " + "))), ds),
         height = svyglm(as.formula(paste("altura_med ~ altura_rep +", paste(FINAL_COVARS, collapse = " + "))), ds))
  })
  df <- apply_calibration(df, mods) %>%
    mutate(ob_med = as.numeric(bmi_med >= 30), ob_rep = as.numeric(bmi_rep >= 30),
           ob_cal = as.numeric(bmi_cal >= 30),
           emp2 = factor(case_when(trab == "Employed" ~ "High", trab == "Unemployed" ~ "Low"),
                         levels = c("High", "Low")))
  res <- list()
  for (lab in names(SEXES)) {
    dd <- df %>% filter(sexo == SEXES[lab])
    for (s in SEP) dd[[paste0(s, "_rid")]] <- ridit(dd[[s]], dd$ponderador1)
    dsx <- make_design(dd)
    for (sl in names(SEP)) for (ol in names(OUT)) {
      fits <- ineq_fits(dsx, OUT[[ol]], SEP[[sl]])
      for (ms in names(fits)) res[[length(res) + 1]] <- tibble(
        sex = lab, SEP = sl, BMI = ol, measure = ms,
        est = coef(fits[[ms]])[2], se = SE(fits[[ms]])[2])
    }
  }
  bind_rows(res)
}
mi_res <- bind_rows(lapply(1:N_IMP, function(i) mi_one(complete(imp, i)) %>% mutate(imp = i)))
tableS10 <- mi_res %>%
  group_by(sex, SEP, BMI, measure) %>%
  summarise(q = mean(est), u = mean(se^2), b = var(est), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(se = sqrt(u + (1 + 1 / N_IMP) * b),
         value = case_when(
           measure %in% c("logPR", "logRII") ~ sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", exp(q), exp(q - 1.96 * se), exp(q + 1.96 * se)),
           TRUE ~ sprintf("%.1f (%.1f to %.1f)", 100 * q, 100 * (q - 1.96 * se), 100 * (q + 1.96 * se))),
         measure = sub("log", "", measure)) %>%
  select(sex, SEP, BMI, measure, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = value)
tableS10
save_csv(tableS10, "TableS10_multiple_imputation")
```
